tender.title: Event Management Services
tender.description:
Provision of Event Management Services to The Pensions Regulator. 

This contract has an initial period of 12 months. This contract provides the option for 2 further 12 month extension beyond the initial period. 

This contract will be on an ad hoc usage basis with each piece of work quoted for based on the pricing schedule and a £0 value commitment. The upper budget number of £400,000 (inc VAT) included in this notice represents an approximate upper cap for the contract over it's total life including the 2 x 12-month extension options.

tender.title: C488771 People Change, Workforce Transition and Change Communications Service
tender.description:
The Supplier shall provide specialist workforce transition, organisational change, organisational design, employee relations, governance, programme management and change communications support to NHS England.

The Services shall support NHS England's workforce transition and organisational change priorities arising from organisational restructuring, workforce reductions, departmental transfers, service transformation programmes and other people change initiatives.

tender.title: Community: Ultra Sound
tender.description:
The Authority required two fixed-location ultrasound scanners to establish a new community ultrasound service at the Tessa Jowell Health Centre, East Dulwich, supporting the shift of diagnostic care closer to home and reducing pressure on acute imaging services. 

This was procured directly via the NHS Supply Chain National Framework Agreement for Ultrasound 2022 (reference 2021/S 000-007768) and is a one-off capital equipment purchase.

The Authority required the replacement of the end-of-life fluoroscopy system in Endoscopy Room 4, King's College Hospital, with a multipurpose fluoroscopy system, to maintain a safe and reliable endoscopy and fluoroscopy service and to improve image quality, patient experience and clinical workflow.

This was procured directly via the NHS Supply Chain National Framework Agreement for Fluoroscopy 2022 (reference 2021/S 000-007768) and is a one-off capital equipment purchase.

The Authority required the replacement of an end-of-life X-ray system at Orpington Hospital, with a universal digital radiographic X-ray system, to restore reliable and resilient core diagnostic capacity within a community-based setting and reduce the risk of downtime and service disruption.

This was procured directly via the NHS Supply Chain National Framework Agreement for X-Ray Static 2022 (reference 2021/S 000-007768) and is a one-off capital equipment purchase.

Three UK software contracts with published end dates in 2027 (sample)

These are awarded contracts, not open tenders. Each date below is the published end of the contract period. It is not a confirmed renewal, re-tender or bidding opportunity: the buyer may extend, stop, change supplier through a framework, or do nothing public.

Source: Contracts Finder OCDS award search, notices published 9 to 13 November 2026 (official API, SHA-256 of the fetched response 48c34ed08f5f73dbf05328251c53fee6a22da5dab14afdbcff64034b3d9af8ae).
